chunks: [Counselling people:] Beware! What had been ordained has occurred, and that which had been destined has come into play. And I am speaking to you with the promise and proof of Allah,

Allah the Sublime, has said: 'Verily, those who say: Our Lord is Allah! and persevere aright, the angels descend upon them (saying): ‘Fear ye not, nor be grieved, and receive the glad tidings of the Garden which ye were promissed’.'
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of divine decree and the promise of Paradise for the steadfast in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) grounds his discourse in the certainty of divine decree (al-Qada wa al-Qadar) to establish the authority of his message as the fulfillment of God's promise. By citing Quran 41:30, he links the theological concept of steadfastness (istiqamah) with the eschatological reward of angelic greeting, a key theme in Shia exegesis regarding the endurance of the faithful during trials. This connection underscores the practical implication that maintaining doctrinal purity and following the Sunnah leads directly to divine assurance and Paradise.
